column1: # The Rust API's point-in-zone answers (spacelab::zone::Zone::contains), exactly (Ф31.C).
# Written by crates/spacelab/tests/bridge_zone_contains.rs; the C ABI and the Python bridge must reproduce it. A double is the 16 hex digits of its bits.

# Angles are geodetic radians on WGS 84, as every bridge takes them. A zone lies on the left of each edge, the shortest geodesic to the next vertex; a refused case answers no point. Rows, tab-separated:
#   point   <case> <index> <latitude rad> <longitude rad> <inside: 1 or 0, - if refused>
